newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina, Britain see Falkland oil tender in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Argentina, Britain see Falkland oil tender in 1997.

text.p: A joint Anglo-Argentine committee on oil exploration around the disputed Falkland Islands confirmed the countries will call another exploration tender in late 1997, Argentina's foreign ministry said on Wednesday.

The South West Atlantic Hydrocarbons Commission met in London on Tuesday and decided to recommend to the Argentine and British governments that they permit seismic and aerial studies in the area to be tendered to start in February.
The new zone to be tendered, the "Special Cooperation Area," straddles the median line between the islands and the Argentine mainland.
The Falkland Islands government awarded exploration permits to 12 companies in October for areas claimed by Britain.
The commission's next meeting will be in Buenos Aires in the first half of 1997, Argentina's Foreign Ministry said.
Britain won a war with Argentina over the Falklands in 1982. Argentina also claims the islands.
